title: dot tool list v1
description: Printed by `dot tool list --json`: every toolchain version mise lists, one entry per version, with the configuration that requests it.

name.description: The tool as mise names it, backend included (aqua:FiloSottile/age)

version.description: The resolved version; empty when mise has none

requested.description: The version the configuration asks for (latest, 1.3)

source.description: The configuration file that requests it; null for an orphan install
